ODS-R1-SOURCE.purpose: The raw artifact is the recognized laboratory roster attached to the official CDC page.
checklist: The landing page is https://www.cdc.gov.tw/Category/Page/02d-tR1nzB8QuflX-NmM_w on www.cdc.gov.tw over HTTPS.
Exactly one attachment link is labelled 傳染病認可檢驗機構名冊<7-digit version>.ods and points to a /File/Get/ path on www.cdc.gov.tw.
The download file name equals the attachment label; the ZIP carries the ODS mimetype.
fetch.json is canonical and its artifact size and SHA-256 match the stored raw ODS.
Attribution names 衛生福利部疾病管制署, the roster version and the CDC open data declaration URL; the service is described as not official and not endorsed by CDC.

ODS-R1-STRUCTURE.purpose: Every method row of the roster is preserved with its merged values rebuilt from declared spans only.
checklist: Exactly one non-empty sheet named <version>名冊, matching the attachment version.
The header equals the 12 researched columns in order; no value appears beyond column 12.
Covered cells inherit only from the anchor whose number-rows-spanned covers them; a real blank cell stays blank.
Each certificate, disease, purpose and method combination stays its own row; repeated upstream rows are kept and told apart by spreadsheet row number.
The curated database holds every parsed row once with its sheet name, expanded row number and row hash.
An independent parser compares every curated row with the raw ODS before the pointer switches.

ODS-R1-CONTENT.purpose: The served values keep the meaning of the official roster.
checklist: Certificate numbers and disease codes stay strings with leading zeros and letters, for example 002a and 19SC.
結束時間 is shown under its own name and never expanded into a certificate validity period.
最近一次年度能力試驗審查 keeps a date, 無需能力試驗 or a blank as the raw value.
A roster match is never described as confirming current acceptance of specimens or eligibility; results carry does_not_confirm_current_acceptance=true.
No official update frequency is claimed; results show the roster version and the last check time.

PUB-R1-OWNER.purpose: The build may be served by the local MCP runtime and redistributed as a GitHub Release download bundle.
checklist: Only an installed distribution may publish.
Every official result carries provenance attribution, the roster version and the note 非疾管署官方服務，內容以疾管署公告為準。
Review records and golden cases name the reviewer as ai-reviewer:claude-opus-5, never as a person or as the owner.
Download bundles contain only the raw revision and the curated build with its audit folder (docs/adr/0004-cdc-snapshot-release-bundle.md).
